title: Morgan Stanley Joins NEXTPredict as Prediction Markets Bet on 'More Institutional' Play
preview: The bulk of prediction market trades are still sports bets, while valuations are predicated on rising institutional interest.

title: Morning Minute: BlackRock Leans Deeper Into Tokenization with Ondo
preview: The biggest financial institutions in the world are bringing more products onchain, and the pace is accelerating.

title: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth Holds Bitcoin in a Coinbase Wallet, Filing Shows
preview: Two entries in his annual disclosure put the holding somewhere between $16,000 and $65,000, alongside more than $1 million in cash.

title: KelpDAO Developer Sues LayerZero Over $292M Bridge Exploit
preview: Evercrest says LayerZero approved the single-verifier configuration in writing multiple times, then warned a different developer about it.

title: Researchers Publish 'Zcash-Style' Design for Private Bitcoin Transfers
preview: The Shielded Bitcoin spec hides senders, receivers and amounts, but leaves how BTC enters and exits the system to a later paper.

title: Federal Reserve Unveils Stablecoin Rules on Reserves and Capital
preview: The central bank opened two proposals for comment under the GENIUS Act, requiring issuers it supervises to back tokens fully with safe assets and creating an application process for banks seeking to issue stablecoins.
